Reference / fs/error

fs/error#

Everything that goes wrong with a file, a directory or a path is a FileError; the cases about one path carry it.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let text = try {
    File(Path("notes.txt")).text().content();
}
catch FileError.not_found(path) {
    "";
};

Description#

Everything that goes wrong with a file, a directory or a path is a FileError; the cases about one path carry it.

FileFailure turns a failed runtime/fs call into its FileError, for the fs modules built on the runtime; a call on an open handle names no path.

Public API#

A runtime failure turned into the FileError it means; std uses it.

enum FileError#

enum FileError is Error = (not_found(path is string), already_exists(path is string), permission_denied(path is string), not_empty(path is string), not_symbolic_link(path is string), invalid_hard_link_source(path is string), invalid_text(path is string), invalid_operation(message is string), unsupported_encoding(name is string), failed(code is string, message is string))

Everything that goes wrong with files, directories and paths; each case names the path or says what failed.
